195. To the Old Oterium (1)
Oterium.

It was the capital of Vankella over five hundred years ago. After the Holy Kingdom Defense War broke out, the territories of Vankella, including Oterium, became desolate lands uninhabitable by humans.
As a result, the Holy Kingdom relocated the entire nation to the center of the continent, and the old territory of Vankella has remained an unprotected area ever since.

During his apprentice knight days, Jin had exterminated the Dark Magic Society of Kinzelo, who were conducting a living golem experiment in Old Oterium. He also acquired the legacy of Rielle Zipple there and faced Orgal for the first time.
The land had a complex history of fate and adversity with Jin.
"The old Oterium..."
Jin mused on the conversation he had with Runcandel, staring out the window.

Tasha had died there, dealing with the remaining demons. At that time, thanks to the heroic activities of heroes including her, the Holy Kingdom Defense Alliance was able to completely exterminate the remnants of the demons, but they never found the actual underworld.

In the end, the Holy Kingdom Defense War concluded with the victory of Vankella and the allied forces, and since the demons did not appear any more, the underworld investigation team disbanded without completing their mission.
The two great families had already spilled too much blood. Several family heads died, and the number of casualties among knights and wizards was innumerable.
"But strangely enough, there are no records..."
At Jin's words, his comrades nodded in agreement.
"Yes, my Lord. Even if the two great families considered their excessive losses as a justification, the remaining records about Oterium are too few."

As soon as the meeting was over, Leht ordered his butlers and scribes to comb through the records about the Holy Kingdom Defense War currently kept in the Sword Garden. But nowhere were there any records about the 'location of the underworld'.
"Runcandel might have lost many records due to the Hunsinjeon, which is understandable. But it's strange that there are also no related records in the Holy Kingdom..."
Syris had immediately visited the Holy Kingdom, but Lani also knew very little about it. That is, neither Runcandel nor the Holy Kingdom had any records.

"Even if Runcandel and the Holy Kingdom intended to hide the damage from the Holy Kingdom Defense War, it's strange that there are no records at all. At least, they would have left some records that only the heads of families or the Holy King could check."

"Even if Runcandel and the Holy Kingdom intended to hide the situation of the damage from the Holy Kingdom Defense War, it's strange that there are no records at all. At least, they would have left some records that only the heads of families or the Holy King could check."
"Either there was external pressure not to leave any records in the Holy Kingdom and Runcandel, or there was some kind of historical manipulation... it's one of the two."
Jin made that judgment.
If not, there would be no way to explain the loss of such a critical part of history, one of the most significant events in all of human history.
Whether it was external pressure or historical manipulation.
The only one who could do such a thing to Runcandel and the Holy Kingdom was obviously Zipple. Also, the records that the current colleagues could not verify were likely only attributable to Zipple.
"Lady Tasha said at the time that Zipple would not have had the resources to pressure Runcandel. After the war, both great families suffered significant losses."
"Then we have more reason to suspect historical manipulation, Master."
"Yes. Unable to exert visible pressure, they probably chose to secretly erase history."

"As both Sir Alpen and Lady Tasha, who were at the heart of the event, were dead, there would have been fewer obstacles to historical manipulation. As Lord Leht said, neither of them would have had the power of existence."
-"Elona Zipple and 3,036 other magicians tried to manipulate the history of Temar Runcandel, but failed to overcome his great power of existence."
The power of existence.

The first time he had confirmed that name was in the third tomb of Temar, where Leht was located in the subspace. Leht speculated that if Zipple had manipulated the history of the Holy Kingdom Defense War, it would have been possible because the two were absent.
"Zipple knew that the underworld existed beneath this world. But even Shinue didn't know its exact location."

"Then Zipple did manipulate the history that Lady Tasha was looking for the location of the underworld, but it means they did not know about the location discovered by the investigation team at the time, the old Oterium?"

"Currently, that seems to be the most likely. Zipple was not a part of Lady Tasha's investigation team. Only Lady Tasha and the black knights of the time knew about the relationship between the old Oterium and the underworld."
The puzzle pieces were falling into place one by one.

"Sanna assumed that Zipple knew the location of the underworld. But when she actually started collaborating with Zipple, they seemed unaware of the location. So she intended to find the entrance by destroying the entire ground through Zipple's power. And the reason Sanna did not connect with Orgal, who is presumed to already know the location of the underworld, is because their goals are different."

"I also come to that conclusion, Jin. And even if Zipple knew the location of the underworld, they wouldn't have shared it directly with Sanna. According to Shinue, Veradin and Sanna are using each other. They won't hand over what the other wants until they have completely taken advantage of each other."
"Veradin, Sanna..."
Jin thought for a moment about the two of them. The reason they suddenly came together.

"......Holy Land. The Holy Land of Zipple is the land where the lingering energy of the Sun God remains. Veradin is likely trying to use the special power that this land has through Sanna. I don't think Veradin has become a follower of the Sun God, and perhaps even the Sun God is intended to be stored in the Demon Stone."
For example, Veradin is using Sanna to contain the Sun God in the Demon Stone, and Sanna is using Veradin to resurrect the Sun God.
That was Jin's conclusion.

"I understand why Shinu asked for help. Whether Veradin and Sanna, either side achieves their goal, there is no place for Shinu. Zipple must have judged the core of the Demon Stone to be the spirit I possess and Shinu's power, but now they have found an alternative."
Looking back, at some point, Zipple stopped coveting the power of the shadow Jin possessed.
-This ambush is commendable. But you and your god will be the most important ingredients for the Demon Stone, Jin Runcandel...!
-Capture Jin Runcandel, he must not be swallowed by chaos!
The words of Andrey Zipple on the uninhabited island of the old empire, and Kelliark during the Sword Emperor's War.
Since it was revealed that Jin was a contractor, Zipple has been constantly trying to contain the power of the shadow in the Demon Stone.
However, after the Evil God War, they didn't show such a posture. It could be because Jin turned into a giant, but recently, Jin didn't feel at all that Zipple was after his power.
Instead, Veradin showed confidence when he revealed the Holy Land and the biological golems of the Magic Swordsman.
"According to Orgal, the Sun God is the beginning of this world, so it wouldn't be strange if the Sun God had a higher power than Solderet."
"So that means Shinu was discarded. You're not affiliated with Zipple, so there's nothing to abandon."
"It seems like we've covered everything we can discuss head-to-head. Now we need to go directly to Otelium."
The old Otelium they arrived at on the Red Owl was filled with the remnants of the battle that Jin fought with the Dark Magic Association alongside Murakan.
Suddenly, memories of that time came flooding back.
The citizens of the holy country who were sacrificed in the biological golem experiment, and Saint Mutual Silla who fought in hiding until the end to reveal the truth and sacrificed himself.
Jin closed his eyes for a moment to pay tribute to them. His companions who were with him also followed Jin in silence.
"...... The traces of the battle are impressive. Were you already a 10-star even during your reserve Knight phase, Jin?"
Hedo spoke while scanning the place where the castle of the Dark Magic Association used to be.

"No, at that time, Murakan handled most of the actual fighting. And I was able to exert much more power than usual by synchronizing with Tess. The cold Jo had pulled out a golem made using the Phoenix in front of Tess."
The ruins of the destroyed Dark Magic Association exuded a desolate atmosphere. Along with traces of the battle, sporadically, areas contaminated by the chaos left by Gliyak were also noticeable.
"We're indirectly experiencing tales of Jin's youthful days. Ah! Such joy."
"Miss, we are here for work."
"Shut up! I'll be imagining Jin's heroic figure while touching these sword marks, so you do the work."
With Sandra quickly removing herself from the scene like that, the group was able to focus on their investigation immediately. Valeria shook her head, seemingly helpless, at Sandra's behavior.
Of course, Valeria was brought to the old Otelium to investigate the records. Hedo came along to prepare for any eventualities, and Sandra just followed.
However, there was no particular content described in the record window.

"Due to the fact that part of the area was contaminated by chaos, the records aren't catching well. Or it might be because there aren't any special records to begin with. When you were a reserve knight, I also visited here to check the records."
-It would be best to acquire Rioll Zipple's magic book as soon as possible.
-Is someone else after that magic book?
-Yes. Recently, a wizard I've been watching is after that book. It's a human girl named Aria Owlheart, like you, she was born with quite a special fate.
Words that Misha told Jin about Rioll's legacy in the past.
Just as she said, Valeria had tried to get Rioll's legacy a few years ago by visiting this place but had to leave without any gains.

"Seeing that the records are not caught even though my abilities have increased since then, it means that Kinzelo has not visited here recently. Or...underground. Shinu said the place where the gate to the underworld is located is underground, right?"
"That's right."

"If Kinzelo took some action in the deep underground of Otelium, the records might not show up due to the distance. For example, if the gate to the underworld exists several miles underground, you have to approach closer."
The area where an event occurred is a very important element in the record magic. Without close proximity to the scene, relevant records can't be obtained.
Jin pondered for a moment, then quickly came to a conclusion.
"Then we'll have to start digging here from now on. Until something comes up."
